# Themes — the positions board

Who stands where on each axis, and against whom. Curated by the revise stage
episode by episode, touching only the axes an episode actually moved; the
block headers share the fixed theme vocabulary with the `themes:` front-matter
on each analysis. Synthetic fixture content throughout — no real guest, call
or position appears here.

## The long end
`long-end-yields`

| Guest | Position | Since | Episode |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fixture Guest A | Long-end yields move on term premium, not inflation | 2026-01-15 | #901 |
| Fixture Guest C | The long end is priced for scarcity, not default | 2026-01, revised 2026-01-22 | #902 |

The two agree on the direction and part company on the mechanism: one reads the
move as premium, the other as scarcity. Synthetic commentary for the fixture,
kept short because only the shape is load-bearing here.

### What resolves it
A term-premium read and a scarcity read resolve on different prints; the next
auction cycle is the cleanest synthetic test of which one is doing the work.
